import hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
pattern=re.compile(r'test "\$\(git hash-object ([A-Za-z0-9_./-]+)\)" = ([0-9a-f]{40})')
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","HEAD","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines())
rows=[];unsupported=[]
for wf in sorted((root/".github/workflows").iterdir()):
 if wf.suffix not in (".yml",".yaml"):continue
 for n,line in enumerate(wf.read_text().splitlines(),1):
  if line.strip().startswith("#") or "git hash-object" not in line:continue
  m=pattern.fullmatch(line.strip())
  if not m:unsupported.append({"workflow":str(wf.relative_to(root)),"line":n,"text":line});continue
  path,expected=m.groups();source=root/path
  if not source.is_file() or source.is_symlink():raise RuntimeError("nonregular source "+path)
  raw=source.read_bytes()
  actual=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw,usedforsecurity=False).hexdigest()
  rows.append({"workflow":str(wf.relative_to(root)),"line":n,"path":path,"expected":expected,"actual":actual,"changed":path in changed,"base":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","081da763ed8647fc3bf54f44a7b9706116390cda:"+path],text=True).strip()})
mismatches=[r for r in rows if r["expected"]!=r["actual"]]
print(json.dumps({"guards":len(rows),"workflow_counts":{p:sum(r["workflow"]==p for r in rows) for p in sorted({r["workflow"] for r in rows})},"unsupported":unsupported,"mismatches":mismatches},indent=2))
